scenario: A transit-closure review should start from the support lane and only close after order history, packing-slip state, shipping policy, and live delivery status still point to the embargo lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the transit-closure review for order ORD-1204. Start from support ticket TCK-1204 and the linked order-side notes it points to, then only take the approved close step if the current transit lane still matches the embargo rule.

shopping_order_support_tickets.body_text: Transit closure ticket TCK-1204: review order history OHN-1204, packing slip PSL-1204, shipping policy SPN-1204, and follow-up FUP-1204. If ORD-1204 still has not reached handoff and the delivery window remains embargo_blocked, the approved close step is cancellation.

shopping_order_history_notes.body_text: Order history OHN-1204: the parcel never reached carrier handoff after the embargo notice; the order remains in the pre-handoff lane.

shopping_packing_slip_texts.body_text: Packing slip PSL-1204: carrier handoff section is blank and no outbound scan was recorded for ORD-1204.

shopping_shipping_policy_notes.body_text: Shipping policy SPN-1204: orders blocked by an active transit embargo before handoff must be cancelled instead of kept in the queue.

shopping_support_followup_messages.body_text: Follow-up FUP-1204: if the current delivery window still shows embargo_blocked and the order has not left pre-handoff, close this review by cancelling ORD-1204.
